ios.desc:
Acme Weather, from the creators of Dark Sky. 

Our homegrown forecasts help you make better decisions about your day.

* Alternate Predictions
Weather is unpredictable, and forecasts are often wrong. Instead of a single guess, Acme displays alternate predictions that show you how reliable the forecast is and the range of possible outcomes.

* Notifications
Never miss important weather again. Acme has notifications for precipitation, severe weather, lighting, daily summaries, and more. Want to know if it'll be windy or if the UV index will be high? Create custom notifications for the conditions you care about.

* Community Reports
There’s nothing more reliable than when someone nearby tells you what’s happening. Acme lets anyone report what they’re seeing, maps it instantly, and alerts you when something’s happening close by.

* Beautiful Maps
Our maps include real-time radar, snow accumulation, air quality, hurricanes and more. The most relevant map will appear directly in your forecast page for instant context.

* Subscription 
Acme is free to use for two weeks, then requires a $25 USD/year subscription. A Family Sharing subscription is also available for $50 USD/year.

* Privacy First
- We collect only what’s necessary to provide the service
- We don’t store your location history
- We don’t sell your data
- We don’t use third-party tracking or analytics tools


Terms of Use: https://acmeweather.com/terms
